name: Gift box
about: A giant present wrapped in red, with a yellow ribbon and a bow on top.

layers.name: Bottom
layers.tip: Red wool, with a yellow cross through the middle for the ribbon.

layers.name: Sides
layers.tip: Red wool around the edge, with yellow in the middle of each side. Leave the inside empty.

layers.name: Top
layers.tip: Cover it like the bottom: red with a yellow cross.

layers.name: Bow
layers.tip: Five yellow wool on top in an X shape.
